item.headline: Army’s Iowa Ammunition Plant Explosion on Schedule for Wednesday Morning
item.summary: Freezing temperatures threaten to make the degrading explosives even more unstable, while winds could carry a toxic lead plume up to 100 miles away.
item.author: Quinn Glabicki and Hiroko Tabuchi

reads.result: The Army still plans to blow up degrading explosives at its Iowa ammunition plant on Wednesday morning, though freezing temperatures could make them more unstable and winds could carry a toxic lead plume up to 100 miles.
